channel.title: Powell River Peak - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Powell River Peak (prpeak.com)

item.title: What we know about the victims in the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting
item.description: TUMBLER RIDGE — Details have emerged about the eight people killed and two seriously injured in the mass shooting at a high school and a home in Tumbler Ridge, B.C.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge, B.C., teacher says he knew school staff would protect students
item.description: TUMBLER RIDGE — A teacher who helped to protect his students at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School when a killer began shooting says he never felt alone and knew all the staff were doing their best to shelter and protect the children.

item.title: Canada's Auger-Aliassime off to Rotterdam Open final with win over Bublik
item.description: ROTTERDAM — Canadian tennis star Felix Auger-Aliassime defeated Kazakhstan's Alexander Bublik 6-1, 6-2 to move on to the Rotterdam Open final on Saturday.

item.title: Laurent Dubreuil wins speedskating bronze as women's hockey team defeats Germany
item.description: Speedskater Laurent Dubreuil added a bronze to Canada's medal chest on Day 8 of the Milan Cortina Olympics, as the women's hockey team advanced to the semifinals at the halfway mark of the Games.

item.title: Kazuma Okamoto, Jesus Sanchez arrive at Toronto Blue Jays spring training camp
item.description: DUNEDIN — If there were any first-day jitters for Kazuma Okamoto and Jesus Sanchez, it didn't show.

item.title: Bhatia's big birdie runs helps him combat the wind and lead at Pebble Beach
item.description: PEBBLE BEACH, Calif. (AP) — Akshay Bhatia played Pebble Beach by the book in accommodating weather with such a blistering start that he threatened to run away with the tournament by building a five-shot lead at the turn.

item.title: Shapovalov beaten by Shelton in Dallas Open semifinals, loses third set in tiebreaker
item.description: DALLAS — Second-seeded American Ben Shelton is moving on to the men's singles final at the Dallas Open, but not before a tense and physically demanding semifinal against defending champion Denis Shapovalov of Canada on Saturday.

item.title: Canada signs agreement for defence cooperation with Denmark
item.description: Canada's defence minister has signed an agreement at an international security forum to strengthen co-operation with Denmark on defence matters.

item.title: Independent Spirit Awards celebrate indie movies and TV in Los Angeles
item.description: Ethan Hawke, Rose Byrne and Keke Palmer are just a few of the actors up for prizes at the Film Independent Spirit Awards on Sunday in Los Angeles.

item.title: Hundreds of thousands march in Toronto rally in support of Iran protests
item.description: TORONTO — Hundreds of thousands of people marched down Yonge Street to the beat of drums and chants of “King Reza Pahlavi” at a rally in North York, as similar protests took place in major cities around the world.
